title: What do you guys do in Mall World?
content: I've noticed something about certain common places I go to! There's sometimes a man in all black who talks to me. In several dreams I've had the feeling that there's something unique about this person and when I realize it, I get avoidant about speaking. In one of the dreams, I was in a white mansion taking care of kittens. This also happens often, and if I'm allowed to believe in woo here, I think it's to keep me comfortable. One time I was in a white room and looking out of a round window, avoiding answering his questions. Suddenly the ceiling opens up with a beam of light and a silver 🛸 comes down and I feel this intense vibration. I close my eyes hard and wake up. In another, I see him approach the white mansion from outside my balcony. I know to not trust him as I see him walk in. The room turns into an apple store looking white room. He's walking around asking me questions. I remember in this dream I was particularly evasive. I go to check on my kittens and they're gone and I freak out and run around looking for them. In other white mansion dreams, there's a long winding staircase and many other staircases, sort of like a highway of different staircases. There's so many weird dreams. So many!! I think I've been to every common place I've read about here. It took a long time to see a pattern but it's pretty weird to me how consistent some of these dreams are.
